# Zendesk-to-slack

## Purpose and structure
This folder contains the **Zendesk-to-slack** workflow. Its executable nodes use `cron`, `function`, `manualTrigger`, `slack`, `zendesk`. The table and connection map below are derived from the JSON, not an inferred guarantee of behavior.

## Setup
Import inactive. Configure your own credentials and replace REPLACE_WITH_* values. Review external destinations and Code nodes before running.
